summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Robo.ai Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting an amendment to an existing Securities Purchase Agreement for a convertible note facility. Under the amendment, the company issued a Third Note for $2.0 million principal ($1.84 million net) and agreed to issue a future Fourth Note of $11.0 million upon satisfaction of conditions including Nasdaq compliance. The filing discloses a routine debt financing—there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event. It is a capital-raising transaction under an existing facility, not a standalone capital return or restructuring. The notes convert into Class B ordinary shares at a price of $920 per $1,000 principal, implying a discount, but no premium or shareholder vote is triggered. The terms are standard for a convertible note facility; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing does not indicate any change in control, liquidation, or delisting. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation requiring classification under the defined categories.
